component.name: AdobeWine
component.summary: Run Adobe Creative Cloud apps on Linux

description.p: AdobeWine sets up a patched Wine for Adobe's apps: Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Audition, Media Encoder and InDesign. It downloads Adobe's current Creative Cloud installer from Adobe, and you sign in with your own Adobe account. No terminal is needed.
AdobeWine contains no Adobe software and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Adobe. A Creative Cloud subscription is required.
